verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an accounting SaaS with a public API and an MCP integration, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. Multi-entity management under one login is a related feature, not a documented sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
